g.text: Order-A durable write — "log before publish" (acknowledged ⟹ durable AND visible)
Step 1 — durability gate: append the WAL record DURABLE, *before* any visibility
visible-but-not-durable write. The single append covers every
CAS retry (re-appending would burn LSNs + hole the watermark).
Step 2 — publish: the visibility point = the linearization point
Step 3 — commit-rank, then advance the committed watermark
the committed contiguous prefix advances to
cover BOTH LSNs — the ONLY safe checkpoint_lsn
A write is acknowledged *iff* its record is in the WAL:
fsync'd ⇒ replayed on recovery · not fsync'd ⇒ was never acknowledged.
